chunks: And the witness and the witnessed,

key_terms.شَاهِدٍ: The Witness, one who observes and testifies to all things
key_terms.مَشْهُودٍ: The Witnessed, the one who is observed or testified to

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And the witness and the witnessed' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores Allah's absolute transcendence (Tanzih) while affirming His immanent knowledge of all creation. It reflects the dual reality where God is the ultimate Observer (Shahid) of every action and the ultimate Object of testimony (Mashud) by the angels and prophets, establishing a comprehensive framework for divine accountability.
